sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-90g"
sources.quote: Kepler-90g is a super-puff exoplanet orbiting the early G-type main sequence star Kepler-90, one of eight planets around this star discovered using NASA's Kepler space telescope.

introduction.text: It is one of 8 planets known around Kepler-90. Its orbit and size follow Shaw et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-90g"
sources.quote: It is located about 2,840 light-years (870 pc) from Earth, in the constellation Draco.
